weak_dimensions.root_cause_description: The product monetizes the wrong step. Alerts are informational: 'sarkari result' CPC is ~$0.01 and every competitor gives alerts free, so LTV is ~INR 4.5. People already pay at a different step: getting the application done (cyber café INR 100-150/form, CSC INR 25-33) and fixing it (SSC correction fee INR 200/500). Moving the paid unit from 'notification' to 'application done right' changes the revenue model without changing the audience. It remains structural for any alerts-only variant.
weak_dimensions.failure_mode: Free alerts reach 20K installs, under 1% pay for Pro, ads earn under INR 15K/mo, every growth rupee is lost, and the founder quits within 6-9 months.

weak_dimensions.root_cause_description: The headline feature (personalized alerts, eligibility filter) is already free from Testbook, Adda247, FreeJobAlert, Telegram, TrueJobs and Sarkari Scan, and mySSC handles SSC end to end. Incumbents leave the post-alert application work alone (gap_analysis.md gaps 1-4) because it doesn't sell prep and carries liability. That area is not empty: TrueJobs web tools, SarkariFilled auto-fill and dozens of free photo resizers sit in it. The remaining gap is depth (per-notification rule checks against the user's own documents), mobile and Hindi delivery, and serving operators.
weak_dimensions.failure_mode: Any alert or eligibility feature is copied in a sprint by an incumbent with 10-50M installs that already knows the user's target exam. ASO rank collapses.

weak_dimensions.root_cause_description: No founder audience, k ~0.12, creators are competitors, paid installs are not viable at an LTV of ~INR 5. This is partly situational (founder has no channel) and partly tied to the low LTV: if a paid per-form unit lifts LTV to ~INR 15-30 (est.), cheap Telegram paid posts (INR 500-2,000) and Meta tests become affordable. A narrower state and Hindi audience makes channel seeding more targeted. Serving operators (B2B2C) would turn each operator into a distribution node for hundreds of aspirants.
weak_dimensions.failure_mode: Installs stall at a few thousand from long-tail ASO. Telegram admins ban promotion. Paid tests burn the budget.

weak_dimensions.root_cause_description: Not below 40, but borderline. Alert apps get opened weekly at best and go silent between events. An application ledger (gap 2) and document vault add data lock-in, and the correction-window, admit-card, answer-key and DV milestones add more natural triggers per application. Still event-driven, not daily.
weak_dimensions.failure_mode: Users install around one exam, then uninstall during long silent stretches or when the phone runs out of storage.

weak_dimensions.root_cause_description: user_profile.md is still missing, so this is a neutral default. Every pivot needs either Hindi or state-recruitment domain knowledge (rule curation) or operator-facing sales, and neither is evidenced. Together with market_size.json, this missing profile also triggers the 5/7 missing-input discount (x0.714), which on its own caps any variant below ~54.
weak_dimensions.failure_mode: The founder cannot curate per-notification rules accurately or fast enough, a wrong check causes a rejection, and trust collapses.

critical_weaknesses: monetization (15): the wrong step is monetized. Fixable only by changing the paid unit (per-application service or operator SaaS), not by tuning price.
competition (22): the feature is a commodity. Fixable only by moving to post-alert application work, which is less crowded but now contested by TrueJobs and SarkariFilled.
knowledge_gaps: operator willingness to pay (no primary evidence)
structural_weaknesses: For ANY alerts-only or alerts-plus-reminders variant, monetization is structural: the information is free and the intent carries no commercial value.
Liability and trust: any product that touches the application inherits blame for rejections. Courts hold the candidate responsible, which creates the demand but also the reputational risk.
severity_rationale: Not 'fatal': the two floor-breaking weaknesses are addressable by changing the paid unit and the job-to-be-done while keeping the same audience and the same Android/push foundation. Not 'minor': the fix is effectively a feature and monetization pivot (2 variables), and no original dimension is >= 60, so a pivot cannot 'preserve a strong dimension' as the pivot-engine criteria require.
